entries.why: APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #573: adds `communities` to communityContactKeys, so the per-community history on a CRM contact is server-owned like the flat default-community fields; nothing else changes (631 rules tests pass, the parameterised forge/delete case covers the new key).
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #573: the server-field fixture gains `communities`, so the existing forge/delete case now also proves no client, not even a full admin, can write it. Nothing removed.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #573: one CRM across every community: three dropdown filters (community, status in it, newsletter) from community/CrmCommunityFilters, combined with the existing search/type/newsletter predicate through lib/crm-communities, and a badge per community on each row and on the contact card. No write, refusal, dialog or money path is touched; the file's writes, primitives and colours are unchanged.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #573: upsertCommunityContact takes a communityId and keeps a `communities` map on the contact (default + every other community); the flat community* fields stay for the default. Leaving never unsubscribes a newsletter subscriber (Matei's decision).
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #573: appends three cases for the communities map and the subscriber rule; every prior case retained.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #573: departure no longer unsubscribes or hash-blocks a contact who subscribed to the newsletter (Matei's decision); a leaver who never subscribed is unsubscribed and blocked as before, and one-to-one owner email and community notifications still stop for anyone who left.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #573: listContacts no longer turns a left community member into 'unsubscribed'; the newsletter reads the recorded opt-in, and non-subscribing leavers stay out through their departure unsubscribe and hash block.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #573: departure fixtures are now non-subscribers (their only permission was joining), keeping every block assertion; the 'stale subscribed left contact' case is inverted to Matei's rule (a subscriber who leaves keeps the newsletter, gets no block, and is still stopped from one-to-one and community email).

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #573: the phone-layer guards accept the tokens the shared Select primitive itself spells (read from ui/select.tsx, which the primitive guards digest-pin) and the CRM filter wrapper's own classes; any other new token or height still fails. Nothing removed.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #573: appends CrmCommunityFilters to the min-h-11 sweep in sorted order. Nothing removed.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #573: appends AdminCRM's #573 digest to the accepted set; every value above and every read-honesty assertion retained.
